By using Rún you agree to these Terms of Use.

Rún is a private, end-to-end encrypted messenger. You add contacts in person by exchanging a QR code, and your messages are encrypted on your device before they are sent. We cannot read your messages and we do not host a public feed, profiles, or any shared content.

ZERO TOLERANCE FOR OBJECTIONABLE CONTENT AND ABUSE
There is no tolerance for objectionable, illegal, or abusive content or behaviour on Rún. You agree not to use Rún to send, request, or solicit content that is unlawful, harassing, threatening, hateful, sexually exploitative, or otherwise objectionable, and not to abuse, harass, or harm other people. Violating this is a breach of these terms.

KEEPING YOURSELF SAFE
Because your conversations are private to you and the people you add, you are in control of who can contact you:

• Report — if a contact sends you objectionable content or behaves abusively, use "Report" (in a conversation, or by pressing and holding the contact) to notify us. We review every report within 24 hours and act on it — barring abusive senders where we are technically able to, and reporting illegal content to the appropriate authorities. Because messages are end-to-end encrypted, we act on what you tell us in your report.

• Block — use "Block" to immediately hide a contact so you no longer see them or their messages. Blocking is reversible — you can unblock any time from the settings menu.

You are responsible for the content you send and for the people you choose to add as contacts. You must be old enough to form a binding agreement in your country to use Rún.

NO WARRANTY
Rún is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind, to the fullest extent permitted by law.
